scope: All899 ordinary Original printings:295Alpha,302Beta,302Unlimited. Existing frame assets only. A finite source census on reused development references, not an independent holdout or claim of perfect reproduction. Current native/semantic/metric identities and explicit residuals close this audit; publication remains a separate gate.

decisions.rules: Accept the shared fractional/precise policy and narrowly content-matched printed-row reviews. Complete899 native census;33 changed images visually reviewed against frozen aligned scans,866 exact images retain their prior source reviews. No new unsafe layouts or alpha/outside-rule changes.
decisions.flavor: Accept the shared safe policy and three Pearled Unicorn attribution breaks. A4266-render width sweep did not support a blanket wider flavor box. Mixed italic/manual-line/punctuation residuals remain in the queue.
decisions.frameGeometry: Accept the measured shared Alpha/Beta dual perimeter, raster seam repair, paper-panel reflow and two-pixel shorter art aperture. All19 production candidates reproduce frozen measured results and current faces retain those exact identities. Five Unlimited raster geometries retain their independent fixed-profile validation. Savannah source-pattern/art-edge losses remain included; no per-card frame warp.
decisions.references: Only three Stasis rules fields change in this batch. Exact physical scans were independently read and match the field-only corrections. Other896 semantic inputs and all artist/type/cost fields retain their exact source identities.
decisions.fullCard: Accept the audited baseline, retaining all899 measurements and all negative deltas. This is an index out of100, not a percentage or a perfect reproduction claim. No current score is excluded to increase the mean.

visualReview.view: Aligned scan/before/after canonical rules region [50,396,390,198], enlarged1.5x; no new alignment fit.
